events.title: NZ Dollar Rises Amid Risk-On Mood
events.description: The New Zealand dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Tuesday amid increasing risk-on mood, as easing crude oil prices allayed concerns about global inflation and the corresponding outlook for interest rates. Markets were also boosted by technology stocks which mirrored their peers on tech-heavy NASDAQ amid renewed optimism about outlook for large AI hyperscalers.

events.title: Yen Falls Against Majors
events.description: The Japanese yen weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Tuesday.

events.title: NZ Dollar Rises Against Majors
events.description: The New Zealand dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Tuesday.

events.title: Paramount, Warner Bros. Merger To Advance With State AGs Settlement
events.description: The proposed merger between Paramount Skydance Corp. and Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc. has cleared a key hurdle and is advancing after the California-Led coalition of 12 Attorneys General reached a settlement resolving the states' lawsuit over competition claims.

events.title: European Shares Poised For Steady Open
events.description: European stocks are seen opening broadly higher on Tuesday after an AI-fueled rally on Wall Street overnight.

events.title: Indian Shares Modestly Higher; IT Stocks Slip On AI Disruption Concerns
events.description: Indian shares were modestly higher in cautious trade on Tuesday, with underlying sentiment supported somewhat by falling crude oil prices in international markets amid hopes for diplomatic efforts to end the U.S.-Iran war and signs of recovering Saudi oil exports.

events.title: Australian Market Trims Early Gains In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is trimming its early gains in mid-market trading on Tuesday, but extending the slight gains in the previous session, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is moving up to near the 8,750 level, with gains in mining and technology stocks partially offset by weakness in energy and financial stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Track Wall Street Higher
events.description: Asian stock markets are trading mostly higher on Tuesday, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight, as easing crude oil prices allayed concerns about global inflation and the corresponding outlook for interest rates. Markets were also boosted by technology stocks which mirrored their peers on tech-heavy NASDAQ amid renewed optimism about outlook for large AI hyperscalers.

events.title: Indian Shares Likely To Open On Firm Note; Tech Stocks In Focus
events.description: Indian shares are seen opening higher on Tuesday, tracking firm cues from global markets as investors keep an eye on the latest developments in the Middle East and await the outcome of the Trump-Xi meeting in Washington on Thursday, with trade, AI and geopolitics dominating the agenda.

events.title: Thai Stock Market Likely To Open To The Upside
events.description: The Thai stock market has moved higher in three straight sessions, collecting more than 35 points or 2.3 percent in that span. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just beneath the 1,600-point plateau and it's expected to tick higher again on Tuesday.

events.title: Indonesia Stock Market Due For Support On Tuesday
events.description: The Indonesia stock market has finished lower in two straight sessions, surrendering almost 80 points or 1.3 percent in that span. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just above the 6,380-point plateau although it may stop the bleeding on Tuesday.

events.title: Australian Markets Modestly Higher
events.description: The Australian stock market is modestly higher on Tuesday, extending the slight gains in the previous session, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is moving up to near the 8,750 level, with gains in mining and technology stocks partially offset by weakness in energy and financial stocks.

events.title: Higher Open Called For Hong Kong Stock Market
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market has climbed higher in back-to-back sessions, improving more than 430 points or 1.7 percent in that span. The Hang Seng Index now sits just above the 25,040-point plateau and it's poised to open in the green again on Tuesday.
